hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We need to generate all combinations of 3 distinct toppings ordered alphabetically.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Rank or order toppings alphabetically and self-join the table three times with strictly increasing rank conditions t1.rk < t2.rk and t2.rk < t3.rk.

hints.title: Query Construction
hints.text: Concatenate the three topping names with commas and compute the sum of costs rounded to 2 decimal places, ordered by total cost descending then pizza ascending.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH T AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY topping_name) AS rk
    FROM Toppings
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(t1.topping_name, ',', t2.topping_name, ',', t3.topping_name) AS pizza,
    ROUND(t1.cost + t2.cost + t3.cost, 2) AS total_cost
FROM T AS t1
JOIN T AS t2 ON t1.rk < t2.rk
JOIN T AS t3 ON t2.rk < t3.rk
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC;
```

variables: N: total number of distinct toppings
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unfiltered cross joins generate permutations and duplicates rather than combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N^3) memory for the output pizza combinations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce strict alphabetical ordering via join inequality to prevent permutations and duplicates.
